invariants.name: full_mask_form
invariants.description: Each element in the array is of the form 2^k - 1, i.e., its binary representation consists solely of ones.

invariants.name: xor_sum_preservation
invariants.description: The bitwise XOR of all elements in the constructed array equals the target integer C.

invariants.name: size_equals_binary_run_count
invariants.description: The number of elements in the array equals the number of runs of consecutive identical bits in the binary representation of C, thereby achieving the minimum possible size.
